final: SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.A2, d.A3 FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE LOWER(d.A3) = 'east bohemia' AND c.birth_date >= '1983-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1987-12-31' ORDER BY c.client_id    -- Returns clients 379, 734, 3428 born 1983-1987 in East Bohemia
